crops.name: Tomato
crops.notes: Start indoors. Plant out after the last frost.

crops.name: Cherry tomato
crops.notes: Earlier than large tomatoes. Good for small beds.

crops.name: Lettuce
crops.notes: Sow little and often. Bolts in heat.

crops.name: Spinach
crops.notes: Sweet in cool weather. Pick outer leaves.

crops.name: Kale
crops.notes: Stands through frost. Pick young leaves.

crops.name: Silverbeet
crops.notes: Reliable through heat and cold.

crops.name: Carrot
crops.notes: Deep loose soil. Keep the bed moist.

crops.name: Radish
crops.notes: Fast gap filler. Sow between slow crops.

crops.name: Beetroot
crops.notes: Thin seedlings early. Eat the leaves too.

crops.name: Spring onion
crops.notes: Sow in small blocks through the season.

crops.name: Pea
crops.notes: Fix nitrogen. Pick pods young.

crops.name: Snow pea
crops.notes: Climbing habit. Give a trellis.

crops.name: Broad bean
crops.notes: Overwinters well. Fills the late-winter gap.

crops.name: Zucchini
crops.notes: One or two plants feed a household.

crops.name: Cucumber
crops.notes: Needs warmth and water. Grow on a frame.

crops.name: Pumpkin
crops.notes: Long season. Stores for months.

crops.name: Sweetcorn
crops.notes: Plant in a block for good pollination.

crops.name: Climbing bean
crops.notes: Pick often to keep the crop coming.

crops.name: Basil
crops.notes: Pinch the tips. Avoid cold nights.

crops.name: Parsley
crops.notes: Slow to start. Soak seed first.

crops.name: Coriander
crops.notes: Sow often. Bolts quickly in heat.

crops.name: Dill
crops.notes: Let one plant flower for beneficial insects.

crops.name: Potato
crops.notes: Plant certified seed potatoes. Hill the rows.

crops.name: Sweet potato
crops.notes: Needs a long warm season. Lift before cold.

crops.name: Onion
crops.notes: Stop water when tops fall over.

crops.name: Leek
crops.notes: Stands in the ground through winter.

crops.name: Garlic
crops.notes: Plant cloves in autumn. Lift when tops brown.

crops.name: Broccoli
crops.notes: Harvest the head before flowers open.

crops.name: Cabbage
crops.notes: Firm heads hold well in cool weather.

crops.name: Cauliflower
crops.notes: Tie leaves over the curd to keep it white.

crops.name: Brussels sprouts
crops.notes: Sweetens after frost. Pick from the base.

crops.name: Celeriac
crops.notes: Keep water up. Roots store well.

crops.name: Fennel
crops.notes: Sow where it will grow. It resents transplant.

crops.name: Turnip
crops.notes: Fast crop. Thin to the final spacing.

crops.name: Parsnip
crops.notes: Fresh seed only. Roots sweeten after frost.

crops.name: Sweet pepper
crops.notes: Needs steady warmth. Grow in a sheltered spot.

crops.name: Chilli
crops.notes: Pots work well. Move under cover in cold.

crops.name: Eggplant
crops.notes: Slow to start. Pick while the skin is glossy.

crops.name: Rocket
crops.notes: Cut and come again. Best in cool weather.

crops.name: Pak choi
crops.notes: Quick crop. Bolts in hot, dry weather.
